hypothesis: Pairwise ranking of success versus failure rows within each labelled historical game cancels the unobservable game intercept more directly than centered absolute-probability regression and may recover temporally stable row-level ordering.
prior_disclosure: The separately preregistered game-centered RMSE source experiment failed. No pairwise predictions or metrics existed when this recipe was locked.

model.fit_rows: historical R rows in games containing both target classes
model.normalization: subtract training raw-score mean, divide by training raw-score standard deviation, clip z to +/-4, multiply by 0.05

selection_order: maximize minimum full-score gain across source years
maximize minimum R-score gain across source years
